newsitem.title: DENMARK: Fog, technical problems close Copenhagen Airport.
newsitem.headline: Fog, technical problems close Copenhagen Airport.

text.p: Copenhagen International Airport was closed on Thursday morning for incoming traffic due to heavy fog and landing system problems, causing incoming planes to be diverted, airport and airline officials said.
"The heavy fog has been causing delays of up to one hour for our planes," a SAS (Scandinavian Airlines System) spokesman told Reuters.
"Now the airport is closed due to technical problems with the instrument landing system, preventing incoming planes from landing. But planes can take still off, though subject to delay," he said.
He said incoming planes were being diverted to either Stockholm, Sweden or Billund airport in west Denmark.

A Copenhagen International Airport Authority official said capacity was down to half of normal but that he expected traffic to back to normal within a few hours. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
